409.description: The bin does not have enough free capacity for this quantity, or the SKU is Hazmat/TemperatureSensitive-classified (ADR 0009) and the target bin's zone fails the placement check (not hazmat-rated, or a temperature-class mismatch), or the facility-layout classification lookup was unavailable for a classified, rule-relevant SKU, or the SKU carries a DOT hazard class (ADR 0010) that is incompatible with another SKU already occupying the target bin (same-bin DOT segregation). The same Idempotency-Key reused with a different method, path or body is also a 409 (idempotency-key-reused).
